allium.consoles.toml:
[[consoles]]
name = "Arcade"
cores = [
    "mame2003_plus",
    "fbneo",
]
patterns = ["ARCADE", "mame"]

[[consoles]]
name = "Game Boy Advance"
cores = ["gpsp"]
patterns = ["GBA"]
extensions = ["gba"]

[[consoles]]
name = "Native"
cores = ["native"]
extensions = ["pak"]

[cores.native]
path = "/mnt/SDCARD/.allium/cores/pak/launch.sh"
name = "Native"

[cores."dosbox_pure_0.9.7"]
retroarch = "dosbox_pure_0.9.7"

[cores.mame2003_plus]
retroarch = "mame2003_plus"
name = "MAME 2003+"

[cores.gpsp]
retroarch = "gpsp"
